title: Peonies in a celadon vase
note: Pink and white peonies in a glazed celadon vase, fallen petals on the table, a grey-green wall, daylight from a window on the left. Alla prima oil on a toned canvas. Written by paintings/peonies.gen.mjs.

lay-in.note: thin colour scrubbed in with turpentine

wall.note: the background, laid loosely with a big brush

table.note: the table top, laid flat and wide

paint.note: ordinary body colour, worked wet into wet

leafy.note: leaf greens: a little more oil, so they have a sheen

petal.note: thick flower paint, worked into itself

clean.note: a clean loaded brush: lies on top of what is beneath

impasto.note: thick creamy lights, straight from the tube

glaze.note: transparent colour in medium over dry paint

celadon.note: the glazed pot: paint with more oil in it, so it shines; a fine crackle in the glaze

celadon hi.note: the window caught in the glaze

bristle.note: a worn hog flat for the wall

big.note: a big soft filbert for the wall

scrub.note: a stiff brush scrubbing thin colour

flatp.note: a small flat for crisp petal planes

dry.note: a nearly dry brush dragged over the ridges

steps.name: Lay-in
steps.note: Thin umber and terre verte, scrubbed in: where the masses sit and where the shadows fall.

steps.name: The wall
steps.note: Grey-green, laid loosely with a big brush: light by the window, cooler and darker where the bunch throws its shadow.

steps.name: The table
steps.note: Warm grey-brown, laid flat and wide; the vase throws its shadow to the right.

steps.name: Leaves behind
steps.note: Foliage laid into the wet wall: a dark loose mass first, then leaflets over it, darker away from the window, so that the blooms stand out.

steps.name: The vase
steps.note: Celadon, painted down the turn of the pot: each stroke one value, light on the left, the reflected light on the far edge; then across the form with a drier brush.

steps.name: Light on the glaze
steps.note: The window caught on the shoulder of the pot, thick and clean, and a softer reflected light on the far side.

steps.name: Flowers blocked in
steps.note: Each bloom laid in as one mass, darker away from the window, with its hollow heart.

steps.name: Petals
steps.note: Cupped guard petals round the outside, then the ruffle, smaller toward the heart, worked wet into the mass.

steps.name: Edges and hollows
steps.note: Petal tips that break the outline, dark creases where the guard petals tuck under, and the deepest pockets at the heart, with a clean brush.

steps.name: Impasto lights
steps.note: Thick creamy lights on the petals that face the window.

steps.name: Leaves in front
steps.note: A few leaves over the lip of the vase and under the low blooms, and the buds on their stems.

steps.name: Fallen petals
steps.note: A few petals dropped on the table, each with its small shadow.
